title: fieldwise-sensitivity-prober-for-structured-output-contracts
creator: Marco Gonzales
description: Build a probing harness that exercises structured JSON outputs across model and config permutations to surface per-field quality regressions tied to model or configuration changes. The goal is to convert signal from downstream structured-output failures into prioritized, actionable diffs for rollouts and to feed a lightweight alert stream for SLO owners.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible harness that runs against a baseline dataset and can replay the same prompts across any model/config combo.
Per-field scoring metrics (precision/recall/validity) computed and stored for each run and diffable against previous runs.
A heuristic to attribute a significant per-field drop to either a model change, quantization profile change, or runtime config delta with confidence levels.
Integration with the existing evals ingestion pipeline and ability to create a low-noise alert when a field drops below configured thresholds.
A demo notebook and runbook showing how PMs/Engs can use the probe to triage a regression and link to a suggested rollback or remediation.
tech_notes: We will implement a runner that materializes JSON outputs and applies field-level validators. Validators include schema conformance, type checks, enumerated value membership, and fuzzy semantic checks for free-text fields (synonym-aware). Scoring uses weighted per-field metrics to produce an overall structured-output health score. Attribution uses controlled delta runs: isolate single-dimension changes (model -> quant -> runtime flag) and compute effect sizes. Store run artifacts in S3 with TTL and expose metrics via Prometheus-exporter for the Console.
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Local prototype and unit tests (branch on evals infra) - 1 week
Phase 2: Integrate with nightly eval job and run across 3 representative workloads - 2 weeks
Phase 3: Hook exporter into Console metrics and add alerting rules with a quiet window to reduce false positives - 1 week
Phase 4: Run for two full release cycles, gather feedback, and refine attribution heuristics - 2 weeks
metrics: Per-field validity rate (fraction of responses passing schema and type checks)
Per-field semantic stability score (fuzzy-match over golden annotations)
Delta effect size between baseline and candidate run per field
False-positive rate for alerts (target < 10% in sample period)
Time to triage (median) after alert creation
test_plan: Unit tests for individual validators and scoring logic
Synthetic regression injection tests (introduce controlled schema-breaking examples and verify detection)
End-to-end runs against CI model snapshots with deterministic prompts
A/B runs that vary only one config knob to validate attribution heuristics
risks: Noisy signals from downstream semantic fields could generate alert fatigue
Attribution may be ambiguous when multiple config changes are deployed together
Cost of nightly runs across many model variants could grow quickly
Edge-case JSON shapes (deeply nested optional fields) increase validator complexity
